To identify the stuntman, I will first search for articles published between January 1, 2015, and December 31, 2022, that mention a stuntman who fits the following criteria: 

1. Stopped being a pilot to work on films.
2. Participated in many international films.
3. Specialized in stunts involving automobiles and motorcycles.
4. Retired from stunt work after an on-set accident.

Once I find a suitable article, I will extract the stuntman's full name as stated in the first line. After that, I will look for a film released between January 1, 1979, and December 31, 1984, that matches the description of being a spy thriller based on a novel and a huge hit in Europe, along with the payment details mentioned. 

This will help me confirm the identity of the stuntman and the film associated with him.
